selectionModel: The Workbench installs all 13 routing Skills, but a task loads one primary route and at most one supporting route. External profiles are recommendations, never implicit installs.

web-product-fullstack.label: Web 全栈产品
useWhen: 要交付浏览器中的完整产品
前端、API、数据与交付都在同一项目范围
conditionalCapabilities: choose one of supabase or neon-postgres
notDefault: Do not install every database, deploy, analytics, or UI replay provider.
doneWhen: API contract and authorization are verified
desktop and mobile browser paths are checked
tests and a release gate match the change risk

backend-service.label: 后端服务与集成
useWhen: 以 API、Webhook、队列、缓存或第三方集成为主要交付
notDefault: Do not add an AI workflow engine, queue, or payment provider without a concrete product need.
doneWhen: input, errors, retries, idempotency and authorization are covered
integration failure paths are tested
secrets and production writes remain approval-gated

frontend-product-ui.label: 前端产品界面
useWhen: 要实现或重构应用页面、组件、状态、交互或响应式体验
conditionalCapabilities: figma only when a source design exists
notDefault: Do not treat a marketing-style aesthetic Skill as the default for dashboards, data tables, wizards, code editors, or native UI.
doneWhen: information hierarchy, loading, empty, error, focus and long-content states work
mobile, keyboard, contrast and reduced motion are checked in a real browser
the chosen design system remains consistent

brand-marketing-site.label: 品牌、官网与营销页面
useWhen: 页面的第一印象、品牌识别、叙事和动效会直接影响转化或招聘
conditionalCapabilities: choose one of taste-skill, impeccable, frontend-design or ui-ux-pro-max
figma when a source design exists
notDefault: Do not combine multiple aesthetic directors, fake screenshots, or motion added only for spectacle.
doneWhen: a concrete design read is stated before implementation
visual direction is coherent instead of generic AI styling
real viewport screenshots, performance and reduced-motion behavior are reviewed

mobile-native.label: 移动端与原生应用
useWhen: 项目是 Expo、React Native、SwiftUI 或原生 iOS
conditionalCapabilities: choose Expo or Build iOS Apps by the real stack
notDefault: Do not copy Web component or browser assumptions into native UI.
doneWhen: target simulator or device is tested
platform navigation, permissions and lifecycle behavior are verified

ai-agent-application.label: AI、Agent 与 ChatGPT 应用
useWhen: 产品包含模型调用、Agent、工具调用、MCP 或 AI 工作流
notDefault: Do not add a framework just because the app uses an LLM; do not expose credentials or silently grant tool permissions.
doneWhen: model, tool, data and approval boundaries are explicit
failure and fallback behavior are tested
observability and cost-sensitive paths are reviewed

documents-data-knowledge.label: 文档、表格、数据与知识工作流
useWhen: 任务输入或输出是 PDF、Office、表格、演示文稿、Markdown 或知识库
conditionalCapabilities: obsidian or notion only when actually used
notDefault: Do not treat lossy conversion as source truth or ingest confidential documents without checking the boundary.
doneWhen: source, conversion method and known loss are recorded
key values, tables or citations are sampled against the original

production-reliability.label: 生产质量、安全与交付闭环
useWhen: 改动会影响生产、权限、支付、数据迁移、事故响应或发布
notDefault: Installed does not mean authenticated, authorized, or safe to write. Remote actions still require confirmation.
doneWhen: risk-appropriate local and remote verification are distinguished
rollback or stop conditions are stated
no synthetic result is presented as production evidence

daily-developer-operations.label: 日常研发与项目维护
useWhen: 阅读代码、排查问题、研究资料、维护 GitHub、整理知识或做小型自动化
conditionalCapabilities: choose one of codegraph or codebase-memory for a large repository
notDefault: Do not index small one-off tasks, retain full chats, or install a new capability before verifying a real gap.
doneWhen: the minimum evidence needed for the task is collected
reusable learning has evidence and scope before promotion
maintenance runs audit-only unless explicitly approved

media-and-content.label: 图像、视频、品牌与内容
useWhen: 交付物是图像、短视频、演示、品牌物料、脚本或内容工作流
conditionalCapabilities: ffmpeg or openmontage when locally available
notDefault: Do not call a static slideshow a finished video, publish synthetic demonstrations as live product footage, or use unlicensed voice or brand assets.
doneWhen: the actual rendered output is reviewed
audio, captions, aspect ratio, rights and export settings are checked

globalRules: All 13 bundled Skills are installed as routes; they are not all loaded for one task.
Choose one primary Skill and at most one supporting Skill for an implementation slice unless independent risk controls require more.
External plugins, authentication, account data, remote writes, publishing, migration and deployment require explicit confirmation.
When an unknown but material capability gap remains, search with find-skills before creating a new Skill.
